title: Centralized Lubrication System
model_title: Centralized (Progressive) Grease Lubrication System for a Conveyor Drive Station

introduction.definition: A centralized (progressive) lubrication system feeds many bearings from one pump unit. Grease is pumped to a progressive divider whose pistons discharge in a fixed sequence, sending a measured dose to each feed line; a cycle indicator proves the whole divider has completed, so a blocked point is detected.
applications: Conveyors, crushers and mobile mining equipment
Paper machines, presses and machine tools

pressure.title: One pump, many points, guaranteed sequence
pressure.description: A progressive divider has pistons that must each complete their stroke before the next can move, so every outlet receives its measured dose in turn. If any line or bearing blocks, the whole divider stops, pressure rises and the cycle indicator / pressure switch raises an alarm — a blocked point cannot go unnoticed. The controller runs short pump cycles followed by pauses, delivering small, frequent doses that suit bearings better than large manual shots.

video_tutorials.title: Centralized Lubrication System — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Centralized Lubrication System.
A centralized (progressive) lubrication system feeds many bearings from one pump unit.

Grease is pumped to a progressive divider whose pistons discharge in a fixed sequence, sending a measured dose to each feed line; a cycle indicator proves the whole divider has completed, so a blocked point is detected.
Typical applications include conveyors, crushers and mobile mining equipment; paper machines, presses and machine tools.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction: Stirring Paddle (feeds grease to the pump element, prevents cavities).
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

video_tutorials.title: Centralized Lubrication System — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Centralized Lubrication System.
Check reservoir level and alarms.
Check every lube point receives grease.
Service pump element and dividers.
Watch for blocked line: cycle fault alarm, pressure high. Common cause: crushed line, hardened grease.
Watch for empty reservoir: low-level alarm. Common cause: missed refill.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
